{{Quote|This is ''Golrath''. We've established one of several scattered, temporary bases here since the Imperial forces drove us away from Hoth.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="marvel50" />}}
'''Golrath''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A heavily [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world, Golrath was at one point home to a [[Magma/Legends|magma]] smelting industry that was largely abandoned after the planet underwent a phase of global cooling&mdash;the planet's volcanic bedrock had unique light-absorbing properties that allowed it to play back images it collected in a manner similar to a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an abandoned magma smelting plant on Golrath became home to [[Golrath Station]], a temporary [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base at the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|We've run tests on the stone, and we've found that it possesses some rather ''unique'' properties. When this particular mineral is heated, as it was on volcanic Golrath, it absorbs light rays from around it. But when it cools, it releases those rays, just as this paperweight has, playing them back like a holodrama!|[[Wella]]|<ref name="marvel65" />}}
Located along an offshoot of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] between [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] and [[Beheboth]],<ref name="beheboth" /> Golrath was a rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Golrath had heavy [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity, and its surface was constantly reshaped with flowing [[Magma|lava]].<ref name="marvel50" /> Golrath's volcanic bedrock had unique properties&mdash;when heated, the rock absorbed light rays that it then released as it cooled, which caused it to replay the images it had collected in a manner similar to a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]].<ref name="marvel65">[[Star Wars (1977) 65|''Star Wars'' (1977) 65]]</ref> Despite the constant volcanic activity, the planet's air was comfortably breathable for [[Human/Legends|Humans]], even without a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]].<ref name="marvel50" />

==History==
{{Quote|And worse, the reason the plant was abandoned was that it had stopped turning a profit&mdash;because the whole planet was ''cooling''!|[[Hanc Thorben]]|<ref name="marvel65" />}}
[[File:Golrath_Station_SW50.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Golrath Station during its inhabitation by the Rebel Alliance.]]
A heavily volcanic world, Golrath at one point was home to a healthy magma smelting industry, with [[City/Legends|city]]-sized plants built within the calderae of the planet's largest volcanoes. However, by the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], those resources had been largely tapped out&mdash;<ref name="marvel50" />the product of large-scale planetary cooling&mdash;<ref name="marvel65" />and the miners had moved on. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the height of the war, Golrath was home to one of series of temporary [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] bases following its defeat at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Called [[Golrath Station]], the Rebel facility was located inside one of these abandoned smelting plants. Rebel hero [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was cloistered for a time on Golrath as he recovered from the deadly disease known as the [[Crimson Forever]]&mdash;the Rebels left Golrath not long after his recovery, as their presence had been uncovered by the Imperial-allied [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]].<ref name="marvel50" />

An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mils Giel]] moved in not long after, in what initially appeared to be a futile investigation of the abandoned base for any Rebel secrets. Although the Rebels left no trace of their passing, Giel's men discovered the planet's bedrock's ability to replay nearby events, putting Rebel secrets at risk&mdash;Rebel leadership on nearby Arbra learned of Golrath's unique stone at around the same time, and dispatched a strike force to destroy the facility. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] infiltrated the base and overloaded its reactor, destroying any trace of the Rebels' presence and scattering the Imperial detachment.<ref name="marvel65" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|Everyone's quarters come equipped with hot and cold running lava?|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="marvel50" />}}
A fiery, inhospitable world, Golrath's surface had few artificial structures&mdash;one of the rare exceptions was Golrath Station, occupied by the Rebels during a nomadic period after the Battle of Hoth. Located in the remnants of an abandoned magma smelting plant<ref name="marvel50" /> built out of the planet's volcanic stone,<ref name="marvel65" /> Golrath Station retained its tarnished, corroded exterior but had a completely remodeled interior bustling with activity, including state-of-the-art medical facilities.<ref name="marvel50" />

==Behind the scenes==
Golrath was a setting of two issues of the original [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'' comic run]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]]<ref name="marvel50" /> and [[David Michelinie]],<ref name="marvel65" /> and illustrated by [[Al Williamson]]<ref name="marvel50" /> and [[Tom Palmer]].<ref name="marvel65" />
